full_canonical_calibration_frozen_protoc.restart: Initial4096-chunk forward-only pass interrupted for throughput before any completed seed calibration; initial protocol/log preserved. No epsilon/grid/function/precision change.

full_canonical_calibration_frozen_protoc.parity_gate: On first canonical chunk, each cached candidate must be bitwise identical to its ordinary model.forward.
